descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Supervisor

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the unit in meeting the set production targets by adhering to the systems and processes. Each day, you will use machinery and equipment on the shop floor. You will also show skill in reading and interpreting the technical diagrams/instructions for assembly of products/systems/panels.

The work model for the role is: #LI-onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Assembly and wiring of modules and systems according to documentation and instructions

  • Delivery of the required quality while adhering to safety regulations, deadlines, and time specifications

  • Clarification of open points with preceding or subsequent departments, as well as preparation of red‑line corrections

  • Compliance with all applicable safety regulations and company operating procedures

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Completed apprenticeship as an automation technician, electromechanics, automation assembler, assembly electrician, electrician, or a comparable qualification

  • Several years of relevant professional experience, e.g., in switchgear assembly

  • Self-motivated and initiative-driven working style

  • Practical approach; employees take initiative and adjust well to changes

  • High-quality work approach and experience handling materials and electrical tools

  • EDV skills to work on your own (digital document processing / basic SAP knowledge / Teams / Outlook)

  • Fluent German skills and good English skills (both written and spoken) are an advantage

More about us

ABB Motion provides innovative technology, products, solutions and related services to industrial customers to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and maintain precise control over processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators and drives for a wide range of applications in all industrial sectors.

The recruiting process is led by Talent Partner Mara Werne.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Call to action

Be part of something bigger. This is where progress is powered, teams initiate action, and we move the world forward together. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Be part of something greater. Hier wird der Fortschritt vorangetrieben, Teams initiieren Maßnahmen und wir bewegen die Welt gemeinsam voran. Run What Runs the World.

Ce poste relève de:

Production Supervisor

Votre rôle et responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion de soutenir l'unité dans l'atteinte des objectifs de production fixés en respectant les systèmes et les processus. Chaque jour, vous utiliserez des machines et du matériel au magasin. • Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • Modèle de travail automotivé et axé sur l'initiative

  • Approche pratique; les employés prennent des initiatives et s'adaptent bien aux changements

  • Approche de travail de haute qualité et des outils de manutention d'expérience

  • Les compétences en allemand et de bonnes compétences en anglais (écrites et parlées) sont un avantage
